title: Signature: Re-identification risk score
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every result set is scored for re-identification risk from uniqueness of quasi-identifier combinations, sample size, and available auxiliary data. High-risk results are generalized further or blocked. The score travels with the result. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers scoring uniqueness and auxiliary-data risk.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 100, 2: 20, 3: 5}
n = CFG[LEVEL]
uniqueness = 1.0 / n
risk = round(min(1.0, uniqueness * 10), 3)
action = "release" if risk < 0.3 else ("generalize" if risk < 0.7 else "BLOCK")
print("result size:", n, "| risk:", risk, "->", action)
